title_vi: Truy vấn khóa không tồn tại: khi bộ nhớ đệm bị xuyên qua

related.reason_vi: Truy vấn khóa không tồn tại là một trong bốn kiểu bộ nhớ đệm hỏng.
Cache-aside là cách đọc mà kiểu tấn công này đi xuyên qua.

claims.claim_vi: A Bloom filter always has a chance of false positives; error rate and capacity set its size; bits per item = -ln(p)/ln(2)^2 and hash functions = ceil(-ln(p)/ln(2)), so 1% needs 7 hash functions and 9.585 bits per item and 0.1% needs 10 and 14.378; past its capacity the error rate grows (unless it scales).
claims.section: Reserving Bloom filters; Total size of a Bloom filter
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: SQLite table of 100,000 products, Redis 7.0.15 cache-aside, 20,000 requests: different missing ids caused 20,000 DB calls with plain cache-aside and with null caching (which also left 20,000 empty keys); one missing id repeated caused 20,000 DB calls plain and 1 with null caching. A Bloom filter of the 100,000 real ids let through 174 of 20,000 fake ids (0.87%) at p=1% (958,506 bits, k=7) and 24 (0.12%) at p=0.1% (1,437,759 bits, k=10), rejecting no real id.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one KVM virtual machine (4 vCPU): Python 3.13, sqlite3 in memory, raw RESP client, Bloom filter written by the author with SHA-256 double hashing.

claims.claim_vi: A basic Bloom filter cannot remove items, and rate limiting is needed against requests for existing keys.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge; not stated in the cited Redis page.

claims.claim_vi: Cache miss attack: data neither in the database nor cached, every request hits the database; solutions: cache keys with null value and a short TTL, or a Bloom filter.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Một sơ đồ trình tự cho thấy yêu cầu đi xuyên qua, rồi hai khung cho hai cách chữa với kết quả thử.
source_deviations: Source presents null-value caching as a solution; the lesson shows it does not stop requests that use a new id each time and fills the cache with empty keys.
The lesson adds a Bloom filter measurement and the sizing formula from Redis's documentation.
